query: SELECT p.id, p.vendaId, p.numeroParcela, p.valor, p.vencimento, p.okConsultor, p.formaPagamento FROM parcelas p JOIN vendas v ON p.vendaId = v.id WHERE v.clienteNome LIKE '%Teste%' OR v.clienteNome LIKE '%Parcelado%' ORDER BY p.id;
